name: DataProposerPolicy
description: Strict Least-Privilege Policy for Data Proposer (Maker / Proposer): Create, draft, and propose terms/rules. Explicit Deny on self-approval, platform admin, and destructive infrastructure mutations.

rules.name: DataProposer-ViewAllRule
rules.description: Allow read-only view on all metadata assets

rules.name: DataProposer-CreateRule
rules.description: Allow creating new glossary terms, test suites, and test cases

rules.name: DataProposer-ManageUnapprovedRule
rules.description: Allow creator to edit/delete own draft/unapproved glossary terms and test cases

rules.name: DataProposer-CollaborativeEditRule
rules.description: Allow proposing metadata contributions (descriptions, tags, custom fields, glossary terms)

rules.name: DataProposer-FeedAndTaskRule
rules.description: Allow creating and participating in discussion threads and approval tasks

rules.name: DataProposer-DenySelfApprovalAndCertification
rules.description: Explicitly deny self-approving, changing status to Approved, or certifying metadata assets

rules.name: DataProposer-DenyAdminAndSecurityResources
rules.description: Explicitly deny managing platform security, roles, policies, bots, and app definitions

rules.name: DataProposer-DenyDestructiveInfrastructureOps
rules.description: Explicitly deny destructive operations on core infrastructure services and schemas

rules.name: DataProposer-DenyDangerousGlobalOps
rules.description: Explicitly deny token generation, SCIM manipulation, role modification, and impersonation
